subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram channel can be wedged by bad persisted session JSON; status should detect and offer recovery

question: Should malformed or oversized Telegram-related session-store JSON recovery be diagnostic-only, an explicit backed-up doctor/reset repair, or automatic load-time quarantine?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent behavior affects persisted session continuity and operator trust, so automation should not choose the destructive recovery policy on its own.

options.title: Diagnostic plus explicit repair
options.body: Status and doctor would report path, size, parse/schema status, and offer an operator-run backed-up reset or doctor repair command.

options.title: Diagnostic only
options.body: Status and doctor would identify the bad artifact and recovery steps while leaving mutation to manual operator action.

options.title: Automatic quarantine
options.body: Gateway load would move invalid state aside and recreate clean state automatically, accepting possible surprise loss of session continuity.

recommendation.title: Diagnostic plus explicit repair
recommendation.body: Status and doctor would report path, size, parse/schema status, and offer an operator-run backed-up reset or doctor repair command.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans plugin status, doctor UX, and session-state recovery policy rather than a single mechanical code path.
